verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated sandbox environment with its own signup and its own API and OAuth2 base URLs. The sandbox comes pre-loaded with dummy data, involves no real money, and rejects production tokens, so tests are genuinely isolated from production rather than a dry-run mode on live data. Switching to production is documented as a one-URL swap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and explicit documentation that the MCP server/CLI can target the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Our Sandbox environment is designed to make it easy for you to test API calls in a safe, simulated version of Mercury — no real money involved.
Tokens created outside of the sandbox (like in production) won't work here.
pre-loaded with dummy data including organizations, accounts, transactions, and account balances to allow testing
Test safely in the sandbox, then swap one URL for production
